structured.answer: A deposit means locking money in the bank for a set time for interest (about 1.8% a year in their example). You can only take it out at the end or on an exit date, and breaking it early has a penalty that can even eat into what you put in. Their example showed 68,270 ₪ left from 70,000 ₪ deposited, so I'm not doing it today.
